desc:
🛒 Hop in your shopping cart and get launched by a GIANT slingshot! Every meter you fly earns you Wins! 🏆

🆕 2 NEW WORLDS! 🍄 MUSHROOM FOREST and 🧪 MAD SCIENCE LAB - the hardest worlds yet, with 54 new pets, 20 new carts and new eggs!
🆕 The HYPER CART, the 👑 ROYALTY AURA and the WORLD BUNDLE - and now you can GIFT them to your friends! 🎁

⚡ Train on treadmills to get more Power
🚀 More Power = longer launches = more Wins
✨ Roll 20 auras - up to the 1 in 1,000,000 BIG BANG!
🍀 Rare lucky launches: MAX POWER, THUNDERSTRIKE and the legendary COSMIC LAUNCH!
🥚 Hatch pets - can you find a HUGE or TITANIC?
👑 The DOMINUS EGG with pets up to 20x your best!
🔮 Fuse 3 of the same pet into a BIG pet, and 3 BIGs into a GIANT!
📜 Quests in every world
🛒 Unlock 160 carts that fly further and further
🔁 Rebirth to multiply your Power!
🌍 16 WORLDS - from Sunny Meadow to the Mad Science Lab!
🎁 Free playtime rewards and daily rewards

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game for more updates!
